description: Create White-label Integration Provider. The "Create White-label Integration Provider" API allows adding a new payment provider integration to the system which is built on top of Authorize.net or NMI. Use this endpoint to create a integration provider with the specified details. Ensure that the required information is provided in the request payload. This endpoint can be only invoked using marketplace-app token

access_token.description: CRM access token (optional — your connected CRM is used when omitted)

body.description: Request body fields for endpoints whose definition declares none (explicit fields win)

location_id.description: CRM sub-account location ID (optional — defaults to your connected location)

name: crm_createIntegrationProvider
